job.title: Senior QA Automation Test Analyst
job.description:
This global organisation helps institutions and firms around the world with their security.  Looking to further grow their Sydney team they are currently seeking a self-motivated and strategic thinker with outstanding problem-solving skills, an analyst who is a great communicator with an eye for detail, a tester who can identify bugs and find defects.  Working within a technically savvy cross-functional team, you will be accountable, show good judgement and be outcome focused.
  
You will have experience with:
  • Analysing requirements and extracting test cases
  • Systems such as JIRA
  • Tools such as ReadyAPI and Postman etc.
  • Frameworks such as Selenium, Appium and WebDriverIO
  • Automation of - Load tests, Performance tests, Security tests, Black box and API tests
You will be familiar with:
  • Brower Stack
  • Experience with tools such as Visual Studio, Visual Studio Code, Rider, as well as JMeter and Azure Load Test etc.
  • Technologies such as C#, PowerShell, JavaScript and React Native
Day-to-day: 
  • Create and maintain test documentation for the QA process, as well as manual test cases and tests scripts
  • Ensure QA processes are followed meticulously
  • Create and execute automated test cases and load tests
  • Perform manual testing on all web, mobile and desktop apps to ensure they meet the highest quality standards
  • Work with Developers to identify and resolve defects and design implementation of automated regression tests
  • Be proactive to progress products, processes, and product quality issues 
This is a terrific opportunity to join a great team culture and a supportive QA team who are backed by leaders and founders who truly care.  With the flexibility to work from home a couple of days a week you will assist to further improve the integrity of these life-changing and innovative solutions.  If you are passionate about software testing, apply now!
